user.title: Patrimony Collection
user.description: Map this Home Assistant instance to one house. property_id must match the backend registry and the iOS Keychain account. Do not enter coordinates or an access token.

error.invalid_timezone: Use an IANA timezone such as UTC.
error.invalid_uuid: Must be the property UUID from the operator registry.

abort.already_configured: Patrimony Collection is already configured on this Home Assistant.

init.title: Configure Patrimony Collection
init.description: Integrator mapping only. The principal never uses this UI.

add_card.title: Add card
add_card.description: Closed kinds: security, climate, network, cellar, arrivals, custom. energy is not a kind.

add_item.title: Add item
add_item.description: Pick an entity and a card. entity_id stays in HA storage and never appears on the wire.

remove_item.title: Remove item
remove_item.description: Remove by item UUID. The UI shows the label and entity for the integrator only.

house_event_key.title: House event key
house_event_key.description: Optional hek_ key minted by the operator CLI for APNs ingest. Never paste a Home Assistant long-lived token.

error.looks_like_ha_token: That looks like a Home Assistant token. Paste a house event key (hek_…) only.

abort.no_cards: Add a card before mapping items.
